documents.title: Corrigendum To Intimation Regarding Postponement And Rescheduling Of The Board Meeting
Intimation Regarding Postponement And Rescheduling Of The Board Meeting Of Manoj Jewellers Limited
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Terms And Related Matters In Respect Of The Proposed Rights Issue.

analysis.summary: Manoj Jewellers Limited reported its financial and business performance for H2 FY26 and FY26, highlighting a strong growth in total income and PAT driven by its B2B wholesale business and new product initiatives. Management outlined strategic priorities for FY27, including commissioning an in-house bangle manufacturing unit, launching a new chains product line, and expanding old-gold exchange programmes. The company also detailed segment-level margins and operational expansions across wholesale, retail, and digital channels. Manoj Jewellers Limited reported strong H1 FY26 financial performance, driven by wholesale momentum, with operating revenue rising to ₹6,914 lakh and PAT increasing to ₹565 lakh. Management highlighted a reduction in borrowings by nearly 77% and targeted a 25-30% CAGR over the next three years.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting 25–30% CAGR over the next three years.
guidance.quote: With this momentum, the company is targeting 25–30% CAGR over the next three years through wholesale growth, curated retail offerings, and continued financial discipline.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced a sharp rise in gold prices and broader demand headwinds.
demand_outlook.quote: We are particularly pleased that our H2 EBITDA margin held steady at 12.16% despite a sharp rise in gold prices and broader demand headwinds — a clear sign that our business model is stabilising as it scales.

demand_outlook.claim: India's jewellery industry is projected to reach INR 9.8 trillion by 2028 at an 11-13% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: India’s jewellery industry valued at INR 5.6 trillion (USD 67 B) in 2023 → projected to reach INR 9.8 trillion (USD 115 B) by 2028 (11-13 % CAGR).

demand_outlook.claim: Southern India drives approximately 41% of total gold jewellery sales.
demand_outlook.quote: Gold constitutes ~85 % of total jewellery demand, with Southern India driving ~41 % of sales — underscoring Chennai’s strategic importance.

demand_outlook.claim: Studded, daily-wear, and occasion-led jewellery are growing at a 15–20% CAGR.
demand_outlook.quote: Studded / daily-wear / occasion-led jewellery growing at 15–20 % CAGR, outpacing traditional bridal (~8–10 %).

demand_outlook.claim: Jewellery e-commerce CAGR is projected at approximately 19–21% for the 2023-28 period.
demand_outlook.quote: Nearly 60 % of buyers research online before purchasing; jewellery e-commerce CAGR ~19–21 % (2023-28).

capex_expansion.claim: Looking ahead to FY27, the company is focused on commissioning its own bangle manufacturing unit to bring a key product category in-house.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead to FY27, we are focused on three priorities: (i) commissioning our own bangle manufacturing unit to bring a key product category in-house, (ii) launching a new chains product line and scaling the Thanga Kovil collection, and (iii) expanding our old-gold exchange programme in line with the Government of India's stated policy direction.

margins_costs.claim: The H2 EBITDA margin held steady at 12.16% despite a sharp rise in gold prices and broader demand headwinds.
margins_costs.quote: We are particularly pleased that our H2 EBITDA margin held steady at 12.16% despite a sharp rise in gold prices and broader demand headwinds — a clear sign that our business model is stabilising as it scales.

margins_costs.claim: A favorable gold-price environment aided realizations and supported margins.
margins_costs.quote: A favorable gold-price environment aided realizations and supported margins, allowing wholesale operations to expand meaningfully despite market volatility.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a flagship 2,000 sq. ft. showroom on NSC Bose Road, Sowcarpet, Chennai, complemented by a 1,500 sq. ft. boutique outlet in Kilpauk.
orders_capacity.quote: Operates a flagship 2,000 sq. ft. showroom on NSC Bose Road, Sowcarpet, Chennai, complemented by a 1,500 sq. ft. boutique outlet in Kilpauk, offering a refined retail experience in the city’s heritage jewellery hub.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is expanding its old-gold exchange programme in line with the Government of India's stated policy direction.
capital_allocation.quote: Looking ahead to FY27, we are focused on three priorities: (i) commissioning our own bangle manufacturing unit to bring a key product category in-house, (ii) launching a new chains product line and scaling the Thanga Kovil collection, and (iii) expanding our old-gold exchange programme in line with the Government of India's stated policy direction.

capital_allocation.claim: Borrowings reduced by nearly 77% supported by improved cash flows and an efficient working-capital cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: Borrowings reduced by nearly 77%, supported by improved cash flows and a more efficient working-capital cycle.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted exposure to risks including the performance of the Indian and international economies, industry dynamics, competition, revenue fluctuations, market preferences, and technological advancements.
risks_headwinds.quote: Factors influencing these forward-looking statements include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian and international economies, industry dynamics, competition, successful execution of the Company's strategies, technological advancements, revenue fluctuations, market preferences, and exposure to various risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking statements are subject to risks, uncertainties, and assumptions where actual results may differ materially.
risks_headwinds.quote: These statements are inherently subject to risks, uncertainties, and assumptions, and actual results may differ materially from those expressed or implied herein.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to commission its own bangle manufacturing unit in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY27, we are focused on three priorities: (i) commissioning our own bangle manufacturing unit to bring a key product category in-house, (ii) launching a new chains product line and scaling the Thanga Kovil collection, and (iii) expanding our old-gold exchange programme in line with the Government of India's stated policy direction.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting 25–30% CAGR over the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: With this momentum, the company is targeting 25–30% CAGR over the next three years through wholesale growth, curated retail offerings, and continued financial discipline.

management_commitments.claim: The company will comply with all compliances and spend the required amount in CSR activities starting from financial year 2025-26.
management_commitments.quote: Hence the Company is required to adopt the CSR Policy or constitute CSR Committee in the financial year 2025-26.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
